scope: repository P2 configs, runners, reports, and tests; artifacts/submissions/raw data excluded

discarded_axes.relative_depth_fourier_encoding: semantic duplicate: an executed joint hydrographic TCN already used fixed nominal-depth sine/cosine query pairs

selected_axis.single_change: one identity-initialized DCN cross layer over the 75-dimensional concatenation of masked public-token mean, masked public-token maximum, and exact v13 context
selected_axis.historical_support: v13 executed all three prefix-purged historical folds with finite 75-dimensional pooled-profile/context rows; training rows were 45935, 119667, and 149384

distinctions.v15: self-attention models token-token interaction before pooling; v47 uses no attention and crosses only the pooled profile with fixed context
distinctions.v16: physical-depth graph message passing uses fixed depth edges before pooling; v47 adds no graph or edge
distinctions.v43: FiLM injects target-layer identity inside each token embedding; v47 leaves the element encoder exact v13 and crosses after pooling
distinctions.v45_v45c: DropConnect masks Linear weights during training; v47 is deterministic and adds one identity-initialized explicit feature-cross transformation
distinctions.v46: LayerNorm normalizes hidden activations per example; v47 performs no normalization
